card.name: The letters CO starting capitalized words
card.fires_on: The capital letters "CO" at the start of an all-caps word, such as COULD, CO-INFECTED, or brand names like COPIKTRA and COLESTID, often in headings or warnings.

modes.label: CO in COULD
modes.description: CO begins the all-caps modal word COULD.

modes.label: CO in CO-INFECTED
modes.description: CO begins the hyphenated term CO-INFECTED in a warning heading.

modes.label: CO in brand names
modes.description: CO begins a capitalized brand name right after a section heading or sentence break.

card.writes: It promotes letter pieces like u, up, and ul, which continue words that start with CO (COULD, COUP, COUL).
card.plain: It fires when a capitalized word starts with CO and the model is about to spell out the rest of it.
